mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verification (email, code, expires_at, is_verified) VALUES (#{email}, #{code}, #{expiresAt}, false)
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, code, created_at, expires_at, is_verified FROM email_verification WHERE email = #{email} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT IFNULL( (SELECT is_verified FROM email_verification WHERE email = #{email} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), false )
